title: The Demon #1
desc:
SUPERSTAR WRITER/ARTIST JAMES HARREN TAKES THE DEMON ETRIGAN TO THE NEXT LEVEL!

The world is infested with a darkness it cannot see. Beasts from Hell feast on humanity's soul.

Enter: Jason Blood.

A man alive too long. Witness to centuries of Hell's victories. A wanderer with a shattered mind and a split soul. Following the mute face—a lost wizard—tortured by a voice from Hell, can Jason Blood protect our world and save his soul? Will the Demon Etrigan rise again?

Superstar writer/artist James Harren creates a brand-new epic starring the mightiest demon of them all!
